hero.eyebrow: // AUSTRALIA CONSTRUCTION CONSULTANTS · THE TOOL FOR SUCCESS
hero.lede: ACC — Australia Construction Consultants & Associates — delivers senior-level construction analysis using the appropriate contractual, legislative, commercial and digital tools for each client. Software-agnostic. Contract-aware. Decision-ready.

methodology.lede: Every engagement is evaluated on its unique contract, legislation, commercial conditions, risks and client objectives. We reject one-size-fits-all methodology.
methodology.callout: ACC does not sell software; we deliver professional construction analysis using the appropriate contractual, legislative, commercial and digital tools for each individual client and project.

capabilities_intro.headline: Nine service lines. One accountable practice.
capabilities_intro.lede: From feasibility through completion, dispute and independent review — commercially aware, evidence-controlled, aligned with NSW obligations.

capability_pack.title: Take our full capability statement with you.
capability_pack.lede: A branded PDF of all nine service lines, our 10-stage delivery process and PERT methodology — ready to share internally or forward to your board.

timeline.headline: Step by step. On time. On budget. Safely.
timeline.lede: Ten stages, four bands, one accountability chain — the same disciplined process ACC runs on every engagement, from a $2M residential renovation through to a mixed-use development.

pert.headline: Every stage duration is stress-tested with PERT.
pert.body: PERT (Program Evaluation & Review Technique) models each activity with three estimates — optimistic, most likely and pessimistic — to produce an expected duration and variance. It lets us plan around realistic uncertainty in design, approvals, procurement, trades, commissioning and handover.
